global_events: US equities staged a late-session recovery after a choppy day marked by tariff worries and pressure on tech, and Asian markets opened higher in response. S&P put Nvidia's credit rating on watch for a possible downgrade over board governance concerns, which could weigh on the AI/semiconductor complex. Copper fell to an 11-month low, a risk-off signal on global growth, while Washington's tariff posture toward India adds a fresh headwind for Indian risk assets.
central_banks: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge (PCE) rose to 3.8% in October, and a Fed regional survey pointed to steady growth with sticky prices, which reduces the case for near-term easing and raises the stakes for 2027. Commentary suggests the incoming Fed leadership may need to lean hawkish. Separately, RBI data shows a higher share of its gold reserves is now held domestically.
policy_sentiment: A reported 25% US tariff on India is the key negative for sentiment, with export-oriented sectors most exposed. India also clarified its position on Hasina's return and extradition, which is a diplomatic item with limited market impact.
stocks_to_watch: Piramal Pharma — Carlyle sold a 7.4% stake worth over Rs 2,211 crore, so watch for block-deal supply and price reaction

research.why: Nature Nanotechnology hybrid core pairing VO2 Mott leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, a direct spintronic neuromorphic hardware advance.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature: coherent time-resolved parity oscillations between four poor man's Majoranas in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains, a step toward topologically protected qubits.
research.title: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

research.why: Nature Physics: two-qubit gates between electron qubits on solid neon, extending a promising new qubit platform to entangling operations.
research.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon

research.why: PRL protocol for high-purity spin entanglement mediated by magnons despite weak coupling, which sidesteps the trade-off between coupling strength and spin decay in magnon-based quantum buses.
research.title: High-Purity Entanglement Mediated by Magnons Despite Weak Coupling

research.why: PRL: a Rashba-type interfacial spin-lattice coupling gives kineoelasticity and nonreciprocal phonons, relevant to magnon-phonon physics and interfacial spin-lattice engineering.
research.title: Kineoelasticity and Nonreciprocal Phonons by Rashba-Induced Interfacial Spin-Lattice Coupling

research.why: PRL: giant room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling in nanocomposite thin films through strain-sensitive polarization, relevant to electric-field control of magnetism.
research.title: Giant Room-Temperature Magnetoelectric Coupling Effect in Nanocomposite Thin Films via Strain-Sensitive Polarization

research.why: Nature news: general-purpose LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) can now design proteins and predict sequences and structures, previously the domain of specialized tools like AlphaFold.
research.title: Watch out, AlphaFold: Claude and ChatGPT’s new biology skills wow scientists

research.why: PRL: syndrome resampling raises quantum error correction thresholds, which helps fault tolerance on near-term hardware.
research.title: Syndrome Resampling Enhances Quantum Error Correction Thresholds
